name: WorkflowModelManagerAjax
title: WorkflowModelManagerAjax - Global
summary: The WorkflowModelManagerAjax script include provides an AjaxProcessor wrapper for the WorkflowModelManager script include. This class derives from AbstractAjaxProcessor.
overview: Use this class in the Workflow Debug context menus.

members.name: getExecutedHistory
members.summary: Puts the execution history into the return parameter based on the query string.

members.name: getFinalExecutedActivityIdList
members.summary: Returns the final execution activity list based on a query string.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
void

This example shows how to obtain the sys_ids of an executed activity list.

var model = new WorkflowModelManagerAjax(); // Initiate the class

  model.getParameter = function(paramName) {
    return {
       sysparm_key_id: "0213a4a607e0011094b4fe4f7c1ed0e2", // sys_id of workflow context
       sysparm_key_table: 'wf_context'
    }[paramName];
  } // Override the parameters while calling from server side

  model.getExecutedHistory();
  var finals = model.getFinalExecutedActivityIdList(); // Get the list of IDs
  finals = JSON.parse(finals);
  var finalarrofID = finals.ids;
    for ( var x = 0; x < finalarrofID .length; x++ ) {
      gs.print(JSON.stringify(finalarrofID[x]) ); // Print the sys_ids of workflow history records
    }
